title: Identify a European context callback descriptor
changes: Identify the independently rooted eight-byte context callback descriptor and its original constructor and dispatcher while preserving its unproved final byte as opaque.
validation: Protected E166 source audit 7hcgos9q authenticates the constructor, dispatcher, callback state path and descriptor and finds no prior owner overlap. Sol /root/sol_context_callback was requested as gpt-6.1-sol/xhigh; effective settings are unconfirmed.
limitations: Typed publication, controlled original dispatch, ordinary invocation, the adjacent two-byte gap, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
